name: Península
summary: Península is a highly-rated modern shopping center in Tijuana's Chapultepec Alamar district, offering a comprehensive retail and dining experience with convenient access from Vía Rápida Oriente. With over 5,100 reviews and a 4.6-star rating, it serves as a premier destination for both local residents and cross-border visitors.
demographics: Península attracts a diverse cross-border demographic, serving middle to upper-middle income families from both Tijuana and San Diego County. The primary trade area includes young professionals and families aged 25-45 with household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $100,000+ USD, many of whom are bilingual and bicultural. The center draws significant cross-border traffic from American visitors seeking shopping and dining experiences in Mexico, as well as local Tijuana residents from the growing Chapultepec and Alamar neighborhoods. Shopping patterns reflect a mix of convenience-driven visits for everyday needs and destination shopping for fashion, electronics, and entertainment, with peak traffic on weekends and holidays when cross-border shopping is most popular.
description: Península is a premier shopping destination located in the rapidly developing Chapultepec Alamar area of Tijuana, Baja California, strategically positioned along Vía Rápida Oriente for easy access from both local and cross-border visitors. This modern shopping center has established itself as a key retail hub in the region, offering a comprehensive mix of shopping, dining, and entertainment options that cater to the diverse needs of Tijuana's growing population and San Diego visitors. With an impressive 4.6-star rating from over 5,100 reviews, Península has earned a reputation for quality retail experiences and customer satisfaction. The center features a carefully curated selection of national and international retailers, complemented by a diverse restaurant collection that showcases both local flavors and global cuisine. Operating daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, Península provides convenient hours for shoppers and diners, making it an ideal destination for families, young professionals, and cross-border visitors seeking a modern retail environment in Tijuana's eastern corridor.
